name: Peppermint Mocha Draft Latte
caffeineNote: Label: 100 mg of caffeine per can, printed on the band above the nutrition panel
summary: Limited-edition Peppermint Mocha Draft Latte: cold brew on reduced-fat milk with Dutch cocoa, peppermint extract and cane sugar, in the same 9 oz can as the Everyday. A label-printed 100 mg of caffeine, with 13 g of sugar (9 g of it added), 6 g of protein and 5 g of fiber at 130 calories. Both the can and its four-pack box print LIMITED EDITION, so expect it to be seasonal. Lactase is in the ingredients, but like the S'mores the can makes no lactose-free claim.
